    Profile

    Creto is a Wadatsumi swordsman with a zealous sense of justice. He is the successor to a sword style that advocates for saving lives called the Sosenko—the sister school to Reimei's Shiba Senko. Although he acknowledges Reimei's unparalleled skill with the blade, he loathes killing and opposes Reimei's way of life.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Male
    Height: 184cm
    Weight: 77kg
    Birthday: Apr 15
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: Rice balls
    Hobbies: Teaching swordsmanship
    Illust: しぶ彦
    CV: 相合谷由馬
